card.name: The word under in area under curve
card.fires_on: The word "under" right after "area" in pharmacokinetic phrases like "area under the curve". It also fires on "under" after a dose, as in "under fed conditions".

modes.label: Area under the curve
modes.description: "under" following "area" in AUC descriptions of drug exposure.
modes.example: a 20% increase in the area<< under>> the plasma concentration-time curve.

modes.label: Dose under conditions
modes.description: "under" after a dose, introducing a condition such as fed state.
modes.example: The absolute bioavailability of a 20 mg dose<< under>> fed conditions is approximately 60%.
